newsitem.title: USA: Faulding gets tentative okay for Acyclovir.
newsitem.headline: Faulding gets tentative okay for Acyclovir.

text.p: Faulding Inc said Friday that its unit, Faulding Pharmaceutical Co, has received tentative approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market acyclovir injection.
The drug is the generic version of Zovirax, a registered trademark of acyclovir sodium sterile powder owned by Glaxo Wellcome PLC.
Faulding said it expects final FDA approval on its generic version when the brand's patent expires on April 22.
Acyclovir injection contains acyclovir, an antiviral drdug active against herpes viruses.
Richard Moldin, president and chief executive officer of Faulding, said the product is a sterile solution that does not require reconstitution with sterile water.
The FDA's temporary approval is the fifth that Faulding has received from the agency this year, the company said.
